examples.en: That is fine. Does the car come with a GPS?

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Halo. Apakah Anda punya reservasi mobil?
dialogue.en: Hello. Do you have a reservation for a car?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ya, mobil kecil untuk lima hari. Ini SIM saya.
dialogue.en: Yes, a small car for five days. Here is my driving license.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Terima kasih. Apakah Anda mau asuransi tambahan? Asuransi ini menanggung kerusakan apa pun.
dialogue.en: Thank you. Would you like extra insurance? It covers any damage.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ya, tolong. Berapa biaya asuransinya per hari?
dialogue.en: Yes, please. How much is the insurance per day?

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Delapan dolar per hari. Kami juga butuh uang jaminan dua ratus dolar.
dialogue.en: Eight dollars a day. We also need a deposit of two hundred dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tidak masalah. Apakah mobilnya dilengkapi GPS?
dialogue.en: That is fine. Does the car come with a GPS?

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Ya. Tangkinya penuh sekarang, dan Anda harus mengembalikannya dalam keadaan penuh.
dialogue.en: Yes, it does. The tank is full now, and you should return it full.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mengerti. Di mana saya mengembalikan mobilnya nanti?
dialogue.en: Understood. Where do I return the car at the end?

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Di sini, di kantor yang sama, sebelum pukul enam sore pada hari terakhir.
dialogue.en: Here, at the same office, before six in the evening on the last day.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Apa yang terjadi kalau saya terlambat sedikit?
dialogue.en: What happens if I am a little late?

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Maka kami menagih satu hari tambahan, jadi tolong hubungi kami.
dialogue.en: Then we charge you for an extra day, so please call us.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Baik untuk diketahui. Terima kasih atas bantuannya.
dialogue.en: Good to know. Thank you for your help.
